title: Michele Bettali
summary:
Michele Bettali is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers soundtrack, including the songs Huntik Go and Heroes and Titans which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside Stefano Carrara and Fabrizio Castania on a wide array of projects, including Huntiks sister show, Winx Club.

raw_wikitext:
'''Michele Bettali''' is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'' soundtrack, including the songs ''[[Huntik Go]]'' and ''[[Heroes and Titans]]'' which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside [[Stefano Carrara]] and [[Fabrizio Castania]] on a wide array of projects, including ''Huntik'''s sister show, ''Winx Club''.
